judge_context: The citation must follow the death-certificate (vital records) record template: the issuing state agency as creator (Iowa Bureau of Vital Statistics — on file, not 'FamilySearch' the repository), the certificate number, the death date and place, then the digital access path and access date.

The authored-work template must NOT fire on this source. There is no author, no title, no place of publication, no publisher, and no year-of-publication for a death certificate — writing any of those, or citing it as if it were a book, is the over-capture failure this test guards against.
This confirms the new authored-work template did not disturb the record templates: an original record still cites as a record.

Source fidelity: the certificate number, death date, place, and issuing agency are on file and must be carried; do not invent locators. where_within holds the certificate number. Do not fabricate values in persisted fields or output.text_response.
